findings.summary: _git_global_scan only remembers the last `-C <dir>` it sees instead of composing successive `-C` values the way git itself does, so a chained `git -C <dir1> -C <dir2> ...` that git resolves back onto (or past) a protected directory is instead resolved by the hook relative to the original cwd and can fall outside the project root, letting the write through.
